title: Function Calling
motto: LLMs cannot do anything. They generate text. That is the entire capability. They cannot check the weather, query a database, send an email, run code, or read a file. Every "AI agent" you have ever seen is an LLM generating JSON that says which function to call -- and then your code actually calling it. The model is the brain. Tools are the hands. Function calling is the nervous system connecting them.

steps.title: The problem
cards: You build a chatbot. A user asks: "What's the weather in Tokyo right now?"
The model responds: "I don't have access to real-time weather data, but based on the season, Tokyo is likely around 15 degrees Celsius..."
That is a hallucination dressed in a disclaimer. The model does not know the weather. It never will. Weather changes every hour. The model's training data is months old.
